from langflow.custom import Component
from langflow.io import Output, SecretStrInput
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright
import traceback
import os
import time

os.environ['NO_PROXY'] = '127.0.0.1,localhost,::1'

class NaukriJobApplicationAgent(Component):
    display_name = "Naukri Autonomous Job Agent"
    description = "Senior AI & TPM multi-tab application automation with dynamic CV routing for Naukri.com."
    icon = "bot"

    inputs = [
        SecretStrInput(name="openai_api_key", display_name="OpenAI API Key", required=True),
    ]

    outputs = [
        Output(display_name="Execution Result", name="result", method="run_agent"),
    ]

    async def run_agent(self) -> str:
        try:
            start_time = time.time()
            MAX_EXECUTION_TIME = 270 

            # Exact paths to your master CVs in D:\ai_job_agent\
            cv_ai_tpm = r"D:\ai_job_agent\CV_AI_TPM.pdf"
            cv_exec = r"D:\ai_job_agent\CV_Executive_Management.pdf"
            cv_core = r"D:\ai_job_agent\CV_Core_TPM.pdf"

            persistent_dir = r"D:\ai_job_agent\naukri_profile"
            os.makedirs(persistent_dir, exist_ok=True)
            
            applied_jobs = []
            TARGET_APPLICATIONS_COUNT = 10 
            processed_count = 0

            # Senior leadership search queries for Naukri
            search_queries = [
                "ai technical program manager",
                "director program management ai",
                "vp artificial intelligence",
                "head of ai"
            ]

            async with async_playwright() as p:
                browser_context = await p.chromium.launch_persistent_context(
                    user_data_dir=persistent_dir,
                    headless=False,
                    args=["--start-maximized"],
                    viewport=None
                )
                
                page = browser_context.pages[0] if browser_context.pages else await browser_context.new_page()
                
                for query in search_queries:
                    if processed_count >= TARGET_APPLICATIONS_COUNT or time.time() - start_time > MAX_EXECUTION_TIME:
                        break

                    formatted_query = query.replace(" ", "-")
                    search_url = f"https://www.naukri.com/{formatted_query}-jobs-in-india"
                    
                    print(f"\n--- Hunting on Naukri for: {query} ---")
                    await page.goto(search_url)
                    await page.wait_for_timeout(4000)

                    # Manual login pause if sign-in layer is detected
                    if await page.locator("a#login_Layer").first.is_visible():
                        print("--> Naukri login required. Waiting 60 seconds for manual login...")
                        await page.wait_for_timeout(60000)
                        await page.goto(search_url)
                        await page.wait_for_timeout(4000)

                    for _ in range(4):
                        await page.mouse.wheel(0, 1500)
                        await page.wait_for_timeout(800)

                    job_cards = page.locator("div.srp-jobtuple-wrapper")
                    total_cards = await job_cards.count()
                    
                    card_index = 0
                    
                    while processed_count < TARGET_APPLICATIONS_COUNT and card_index < total_cards:
                        if time.time() - start_time > MAX_EXECUTION_TIME:
                            break

                        try:
                            card = job_cards.nth(card_index)
                            card_index += 1
                            await card.scroll_into_view_if_needed()
                            
                            title_el = card.locator("a.title").first
                            job_title = await title_el.inner_text() if await title_el.count() > 0 else "Target Role"
                            job_title_clean = job_title.strip()
                            
                            # Strict negative filters to block junior roles
                            exclusion_list = ["engineering manager", "software manager", "assistant", "supervisor", "junior", "associate", "intern", "analyst"]
                            if any(exclude in job_title_clean.lower() for exclude in exclusion_list):
                                continue

                            # Open job listing in a new browser tab
                            async with browser_context.expect_page() as new_page_info:
                                await title_el.click()
                            
                            new_page = await new_page_info.value
                            await new_page.wait_for_load_state()
                            await new_page.wait_for_timeout(2000)

                            # Extract Job Description text from the new tab to route the optimal CV
                            jd_el = new_page.locator("div.styles-job-desc, div.dang-inner-html").first
                            jd_text = await jd_el.inner_text() if await jd_el.count() > 0 else ""
                            jd_lower = jd_text.lower()

                            # Smart Dynamic CV Routing
                            if any(kw in jd_lower for kw in ["ai", "artificial intelligence", "generative ai", "llm", "machine learning"]):
                                selected_cv = cv_ai_tpm
                                cv_type = "AI TPM CV"
                            elif any(kw in jd_lower for kw in ["vp", "director", "p&l", "c-level", "head of"]):
                                selected_cv = cv_exec
                                cv_type = "Executive Management CV"
                            else:
                                selected_cv = cv_core
                                cv_type = "Core TPM CV"

                            apply_btn = new_page.locator("button.apply-button, button:has-text('Apply')").first
                            
                            if await apply_btn.is_visible():
                                btn_text = await apply_btn.inner_text()
                                if "company site" not in btn_text.lower():
                                    await apply_btn.click()
                                    await new_page.wait_for_timeout(2000)
                                    
                                    # Handle resume upload element if present in Naukri modal
                                    file_input = new_page.locator("input[type='file']")
                                    if await file_input.count() > 0 and os.path.exists(selected_cv):
                                        await file_input.first.set_input_files(selected_cv)
                                        await new_page.wait_for_timeout(1000)

                                    submit_bot = new_page.locator("button:has-text('Submit'), button:has-text('Save & Apply')").first
                                    if await submit_bot.is_visible():
                                        await submit_bot.click()
                                        await new_page.wait_for_timeout(1000)

                                    applied_jobs.append(f"{job_title_clean} (Used {cv_type})")
                                    processed_count += 1
                                    print(f"Success! Applied to: {job_title_clean} | Routing: {cv_type}")

                            await new_page.close()
                            await page.wait_for_timeout(500)
                            
                        except Exception as e:
                            if 'new_page' in locals() and not new_page.is_closed():
                                await new_page.close()
                            continue

                await browser_context.close()

            if applied_jobs:
                summary_str = "\n".join([f"{idx+1}. {j}" for idx, j in enumerate(applied_jobs)])
                return f"Naukri Execution successful! Applied to {len(applied_jobs)} roles with dynamic CV routing:\n\n{summary_str}"
            
            return "Execution finished. Scanned Naukri listings but found no open 1-click apply positions."

        except Exception as e:
            return f"CRITICAL ERROR:\n{traceback.format_exc()}"
